content: I've recently been working on formalizing some fundamental results related to Agent Foundations and Open-Source Game Theory with the help of Claude Code in this repo. My plan is to formalize a few foundational papers, starting with Barasz et al (2014) on Robust Cooperation in the Prisoner's Dilemma. Since this paper is based on Godel-Lob provability logic (and many other agent foundations results are based on results from logic), this repo is based on the Foundation repo from the Formalized Formal Logic project. After finishing this paper, a few next targets I'm thinking about working on are Yudkowsky and Herreshoff (2013) and possibly Critch (2019) which is a bounded version of the Barasz paper. Would be happy to hear feedback or thoughts.
Make sure to read @Siddhartha Gadgil's recent posts on the Zulip.
